name: King Orfeo

perks.name: Agile Bowstring
perks.desc:
Durable yet light bowstring.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Tactile String
perks.desc:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.desc:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Flexible String
perks.desc:
Light and easy to draw.
  •  Slightly faster draw time
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.desc:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Natural String
perks.desc:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polymer String
perks.desc:
Unbreakable bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

perks.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Helical Fletching
perks.desc:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching
perks.desc:
Feather-light with good control.
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching
perks.desc:
Modern fletching for straight paths. 
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.desc: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Nail, Meet Hammer
perks.desc: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants bonus Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo, or Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for controlling groups of Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly for Arc builds. King Orfeo is a precision frame bow which are rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic but that might not be such a problem if you look at this as an Arc verb delivery system. The stats are excellent by comparison with its peers - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/3481382332 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. The play, as ever for bows, is to used the bowstring perk to reduce the Draw Time, and the arrow perk to recover or improve Accuracy. In the first trait perk column, Archer's Tempo applies a ×0.75 Draw Time animation multiplier for 3s (4s when enhanced) after a crit hit. Alternatively, Explosive Head boosts bodyshot damage by ×1.15 and crit damage by ×1.1 with increased stagger, and inflicts AoE damage on enemies within 3m. For arc builds, Jolting Feedback applies Jolt after 3 hits (2 when enhanced and 2 when amplified) enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage - unfortunately Explosive Head's double damage instances don't reduce the number of hits needed, though. For the Origin Trait, Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Special Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. If you're interested, King Orfeo is a character from the Middle English narrative poem "Sir Orfeo" which dates back to the late 13th/early 14th century, who rescues his wife Heurodis from the fairy king who abducted her. Recommended MW: Draw Time, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for controlling groups of Minor adds in general at-level or better content, particularly for Arc builds. If you're interested, King Orfeo is a character from the Middle English narrative poem "Sir Orfeo" which dates back to the late 13th/early 14th century, who rescues his wife Heurodis from the fairy king who abducted her. Recommended MW: Draw Time, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

For the Origin Trait, Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Special Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. If you're interested, King Orfeo is a character from the Middle English narrative poem "Sir Orfeo" which dates back to the late 13th/early 14th century, who rescues his wife Heurodis from the fairy king who abducted her.
